name: Workday
description: Workday is an enterprise platform for human capital, workforce, payroll, finance, recruiting, and other highly sensitive business operations.
agentUseSummary: Workday cannot be newly connected under Relay's generic provider-owned OAuth model. Its supported service access requires a Developer Site API client, target-tenant allowlisting, an Integration System User mapping, licensed service/version selection, functional scopes, and tenant domain-security policies; Relay mounts no credentials or HR data tools without a separately approved field-level data-governance contract.

blocked.label: Connect Workday
blocked.description: No generic self-service Relay-owned customer authorization contract is documented.

blocked.label: Read Workday HR data
blocked.description: Worker, compensation, payroll, benefits, leave, demographic, contact, recruiting, performance, and other HR data are unavailable.

blocked.label: Use Workday APIs
blocked.description: REST, SOAP, Graph, WQL, custom reports, business-process actions, writes, and arbitrary provider access are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No actions can be enabled without a named Workday service/version/field and data-governance contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No Workday credentials or tools are mounted.
No Workday credentials or tools are mounted.

providerSetup.blocker: Public Workday access requires a Developer Site API client, Company-Administrator target-tenant allowlisting, tenant ISU/client mapping, functional scopes, licensed service and production version selection, and domain-security policy configuration. No generic Relay-owned customer install or approved field-minimized HR workflow exists.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Workday unavailable unless Workday partner/developer access and a named service/version/scope/field/retention contract are approved, or a separate tenant-owned minimal custom-report/ISU product receives explicit data-governance authorization.

evidence.supports: Workday documents Developer Site API-client creation, functional scope selection, generated client credentials, and Company-Administrator allowlisting for nondevelopment target tenants.
Workday documents tenant Integration System User mapping, tenant alias, client credentials, endpoint scope enablement, and domain-security permissions for service access.
Workday documents different API Gateway and tenanted REST base paths, per-service production versions, and configuration-dependent resource semantics.
Workday's current explorer lists many separately versioned production HR, payroll, finance, recruiting, person, staffing, and platform services rather than one stable generic directory API.
Workday documents endpoint-specific domain and business-process security and warns that ISU access is a security exception requiring additional checks.
